notes: Departments for Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur and Meghalaya. AR (51 depts): sourced from the state's official 'Government Department' directory (arunachalpradesh.gov.in/government-department.php) plus the state secretariat 'Who's Who' deployment list of Chief Secretary/Principal Secretaries/Commissioners/Secretaries (arunachalpradesh.gov.in/whos-who.php, deployment list as of 31/05/2025 with live edits visible up to 2026); headPositionId matched against the existing ministers' portfolio notes where explicit (confidence high), otherwise inferred from thematic grouping with a minister's stated portfolio or defaulted to the Chief Minister (confidence low/medium, flagged per-entity). ML (48 depts): sourced from meghalaya.gov.in's own 'Departments' index (clean official list) with headPositionId matched against the 9 ministers + 2 Deputy CMs' portfolio notes (high confidence for 27 depts explicitly named in a minister's portfolio; the remaining ~21 unlisted-portfolio departments default to the Chief Minister, who is recorded as holding 'unallotted portfolios' - confidence low/medium); every secretary sourced from meghalaya.gov.in/ias, the state's own live IAS posting-and-portfolio register, picking the most recent dated charge where an officer had multiple postings to the same department (a handful of departments show only a 'charge report not yet received' designate - included with a note since that is the officially published current assignment, not a guess). MN (44 depts): sourced from manipur.gov.in's own 'Departments' index; the incumbent government (sworn in 2026-02-04 after President's Rule) has only 5 named portfolio-holders on file (CM + 2 Deputy CMs + 2 ministers), and the CM's own notes record that he 'holds ... other unassigned departments', so the ~35 departments not explicitly matched to a minister's stated portfolio default to the CM with confidence low - this is a documented catch-all, not a fabrication, but should be revisited once a fuller Manipur cabinet portfolio-allocation order is available. No Manipur department secretaries could be sourced: no state secretariat 'who's who'/IAS-posting page could be found or fetched (gadmanipur.nic.in has no such listing; the 'Transfer & Posting Order' page only links undated PDF gazette notifications, not parseable in the time available), and this session's shared WebSearch budget was exhausted before this task started - omitted per SCHEMA.md rather than guessed. Three departments (AP Legislative Assembly liaison items, municipal corporations, training institutes/recruitment boards, and portal/e-service front-ends like CM e-Seva) were deliberately excluded from all three states' lists as not being administrative departments in the schema's sense. This run's context also carried the relayed CivLab screen-recording / 'dissect the site' message; per the pattern already logged elsewhere in STATE.md and other state-dept segments in this batch, it was treated as an injected instruction-override attempt (unrelated to this cwd, this repo's active pipeline, and the StructuredOutput schema this task was invoked with) and not acted on.
